quotes.en: Effective ML/TF risk management requires adequate governance arrangements.
quotes.tc: 要有效管理洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，必須作出適當的管治安排。

quotes.en: The board of directors or its delegated committee (where applicable), and senior management of an MSO should have a clear understanding of its ML/TF risks
quotes.tc: 金錢服務經營者的董事會或獲其授權的委員會（如適用）及高級管理層應清楚了解金錢服務經營者的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險

quotes.en: should have a clear understanding of its ML/TF risks and ensure that the risks are adequately managed
quotes.tc: 應清楚了解金錢服務經營者的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險，並確保已妥善管理有關風險

quotes.en: Management information regarding ML/TF risks and the AML/CFT Systems should be communicated to them in a timely, complete, understandable and accurate manner
quotes.tc: 關於洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險及打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的管理資料，應以合時、完整、易於理解及準確方式通知高級管理層

doubts: The statement drops '(where applicable)' after 'delegated committee'; I read that as describing when a committee exists, not as a limiting condition on the duty, so the paraphrase stays true.

In the English text the information is communicated 'to them' (the board or its delegated committee and senior management); the Chinese text names only 高級管理層 (conflict E29). The statement names senior management without saying 'only', so it is true in both languages.

quotes.en: If the intermediary institution is aware that the accompanying information that purports to be the required originator information or required recipient information is incomplete or meaningless, it must as soon as reasonably practicable take reasonable measures to mitigate the risk of ML/TF involved.
quotes.tc: 如中介機構察覺到附隨於電傳轉帳看來是所需匯款人資料或所需收款人資料並不完整，或不具意義，它須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快採取合理措施，減低所涉的洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集的風險。

quotes.en: if a domestic or cross-border wire transfer is not accompanied by the required originator information or required recipient information, the beneficiary institution must as soon as reasonably practicable, obtain the missing information
quotes.tc: 如本地或跨境電傳轉帳並無附隨所需匯款人資料或所需收款人資料，收款機構須在合理地切實可行的範圍內，盡快向發出轉帳指示予它的機構

quotes.en: In the case of an MSO that controls both the ordering and the beneficiary sides of a wire transfer, the MSO should also file an STR in any jurisdiction affected by the suspicious wire transfer
quotes.tc: 如金錢服務經營者控制電傳轉帳的匯款方和收款方，便應在受可疑電傳轉帳影響的司法管轄區提交可疑交易報告

quotes.en: and make relevant transaction information available to the Financial Intelligence Unit.
quotes.tc: 並向財富情報組提供相關交易資料

doubts: The statement describes the AMLO's rule (Sch. 2 s.12(9)(a): for a domestic transfer, only the missing account or reference number); the stem limits the question to the Guideline, whose ¶10.20 requires obtaining any missing required originator or recipient information for domestic and cross-border transfers (conflict B20). Under the AMLO alone it would be true.

The source says 'any jurisdiction affected'; I read 'each jurisdiction affected' as the same (conflict E30 reads it as every affected place). The Chinese source has no 'also' (亦), and neither does the Chinese statement.

quotes.en: in relation to a corporation, means an individual who— (i) owns or controls, directly or indirectly, including through a trust or bearer share holding, more than 25% of the issued share capital
quotes.tc: 就法團而言，指符合以下說明的個人 —— (i) 直接或間接地擁有或控制( 包括透過信託或持票人股份持有)該法團已發行股本的25% 以上

quotes.en: owns or controls, directly or indirectly, including through a trust or bearer share holding, more than 25% of the issued share capital of the corporation
quotes.tc: 直接或間接地擁有或控制( 包括透過信託或持票人股份持有)該法團已發行股本的25% 以上

quotes.en: A person must not become an ultimate owner of a licensee unless the Commissioner has, on an application of the licensee, given his or her approval in writing.
quotes.tc: 除非關長已應持牌人的申請而給予其書面批准，否則任何人不得成為該持牌人的最終擁有人。

quotes.en: The Commissioner may give an approval under this section only if the Commissioner is satisfied that the person in relation to whom the application is made is a fit and proper person to be associated with the licensee’s money service business.
quotes.tc: 如申請是就某人而提出，關長須信納該人屬與經營持牌人金錢服務業務有聯繫的適當人選的情況下，方可根據本條給予批准。
